stock.description: THAC Group (Holdings) Limited primarily functions as an investment holding firm, with its core business centered on the ownership and operation of casual dining establishments across Hong Kong. Its portfolio encompasses seven restaurants within Hong Kong—five operating as "Classified" and two as "Rise by Classified"—alongside three franchised locations situated in Indonesia. The group also extends its expertise through the provision of management services. Prior to February 2016, the enterprise was identified as Press Room Group (Holdings) Limited, subsequently adopting the name Classified Group (Holdings) Limited. This entity, which originated in 2006, maintains its principal office in Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong.
